rules.clause_text: No scheduled payment on the Receivable is more than 30 days past due.
rules.plain_english: Ineligible if any scheduled payment is more than 30 days past due at the cut-off date. Days past due must be 30 or less.

rules.clause_text: The Receivable has not been charged off and the related Financed Vehicle has not been repossessed.
rules.plain_english: Ineligible if the loan has been charged off or its vehicle repossessed. The test excludes tape statuses CHARGED_OFF and REPO.

rules.clause_text: The original term of the Receivable is 84 months or less.
rules.plain_english: The original term must be 84 months or less.

rules.clause_text: The Obligor's FICO score at origination is 540 or higher.
rules.plain_english: The FICO score at origination must be 540 or higher.

rules.clause_text: The Outstanding Balance of the Receivable does not exceed US$75,000.
rules.plain_english: The outstanding balance must not exceed US$75,000.

rules.clause_text: The Obligor's billing address is in one of the fifty states of the United States or the District of Columbia.
rules.plain_english: The obligor's billing address must be in one of the 50 US states or the District of Columbia. The tape field obligor_state is the proxy for billing address.

rules.clause_text: The Obligor's billing address is not in a Restricted Jurisdiction.
rules.plain_english: The obligor's billing address must not be in a Restricted Jurisdiction. The list of Restricted Jurisdictions is not in the material provided, so this test cannot be fully specified without it.

rules.clause_text: The terms of the Receivable have been modified no more than once since origination.
rules.plain_english: The loan may have been modified at most once since origination.

rules.clause_text: The annual percentage rate of the Receivable is not less than 6.00% and not more than 29.99%.
rules.plain_english: The APR must be between 6.00% and 29.99%, inclusive. The units of the tape's apr field (percent or decimal) should be confirmed.

rules.clause_text: The model year of the Financed Vehicle is no more than ten years before the year of origination of the Receivable.
rules.plain_english: The vehicle's model year must be no more than 10 years before the year of the loan's origination date.

rules.clause_text: The Obligor has made at least one scheduled payment on the Receivable.
rules.plain_english: At least one scheduled payment must have been made.

rules.clause_text: The Financed Vehicle is identified by a Vehicle Identification Number that appears on no other Receivable in the Pool.
rules.logic: vin appears once in the tape
rules.plain_english: The VIN must appear on no other loan in the pool. A duplicate VIN suggests the vehicle was pledged twice.

rules.clause_text: Obligors with a billing address in any one state
rules.plain_english: Eligible loans to obligors with a billing address in any one state may be at most 20% of the eligible pool balance. Any excess is an excess concentration.

rules.clause_text: Receivables originated by any one Dealer, treating Dealers under common ownership or trading under variations of one name as one Dealer
rules.plain_english: Eligible loans originated by any one dealer may be at most 5% of the eligible pool balance. Dealers under common ownership or trading under variations of one name count as one dealer. Common ownership is not on the tape.

rules.clause_text: Receivables with an original term of more than 72 months
rules.plain_english: Eligible loans with an original term of more than 72 months may be at most 25% of the eligible pool balance.

rules.clause_text: Receivables secured by used Financed Vehicles
rules.logic: share(vehicle_condition in used_conditions) <= 70% of eligible pool
rules.plain_english: Eligible loans secured by used vehicles may be at most 70% of the eligible pool balance.

rules.clause_ref: Schedule 2, row 5 (added by Amendment No. 1, Section 2(b))
rules.clause_text: Receivables with an Obligor FICO score at origination below 600
rules.plain_english: Added by Amendment No. 1 with effect from 1 March 2026. Eligible loans whose obligor's FICO at origination is below 600 may be at most 35% of the eligible pool balance. Per Section 2(c), it applies to Borrowing Base Certificates for Collection Periods ending on or after 1 March 2026.

concept.label: Facility limit
concept.meaning: The most the lender has committed to lend under the facility.

concept.label: Advance rate
concept.meaning: The share of the eligible pool, after excess concentration, that the lender will advance.

concept.label: Eligibility criterion
concept.meaning: A test every receivable must pass. A receivable that fails any test is excluded in full.

concept.label: Concentration limit
concept.meaning: The most of the eligible pool that one group of receivables may make up, such as one dealer or one state.

concept.label: Excess concentration
concept.meaning: The amount by which a group of receivables exceeds its concentration limit.

terms.name: Excess concentration treatment
terms.value: Deducted from Eligible Pool Balance before Advance Rate

concept.label: Reserve
concept.meaning: An amount held back from the borrowing base, set as a share of the eligible pool.

concept.label: Delinquency trigger
concept.meaning: A pool test on the share of receivables past due. A breach stops new advances.

concept.label: Tangible net worth covenant
concept.meaning: The least tangible net worth the borrower's parent must keep.

concept.label: Leverage covenant
concept.meaning: The highest leverage ratio the borrower's parent may reach.

concept.label: Liquidity covenant
concept.meaning: The least unrestricted cash the borrower's parent must hold.

concept.label: Restricted jurisdiction
concept.meaning: A place where an obligor's billing address makes the receivable ineligible.

concept.label: Margin
concept.meaning: The interest the borrower pays over the benchmark rate, Term SOFR.

concept.label: Unused fee
concept.meaning: A yearly fee on the part of the facility limit that is not drawn.

concept.label: Interest period
concept.meaning: How long each interest period runs, and the day interest is paid.

terms.name: Interest period and payment date
terms.value: One month; 15th day of each calendar month

concept.label: Reporting obligation
concept.meaning: What the borrower must deliver to the lender, and by when.

terms.name: Borrowing base reporting date
terms.value: 15th Business Day after each month end

concept.label: Reporting obligation
concept.meaning: What the borrower must deliver to the lender, and by when.

terms.name: Financial statement reporting
terms.value: 45 days after quarter end; 120 days after year end

concept.label: Revolving period
concept.meaning: The period in which the borrower may draw and repay. New advances stop at its end.

terms.name: Revolving period end

concept.label: Final maturity
concept.meaning: The date by which every advance must be repaid.

concept.label: Event of default
concept.meaning: An event that lets the lender stop lending and demand repayment.

concept.label: Alert threshold
concept.meaning: A level the lender asks to be told about, such as availability falling below a set amount.

concept.label: Party
concept.meaning: A person or company named in the agreement, with its role and notice address.
